At R.K. Puri Law, litigation is approached with an emphasis on thorough factual preparation, statutory scrutiny, and disciplined courtroom advocacy. Whether representing an accused person in complex criminal proceedings or resolving commercial disputes, the firm develops strategies tailored to the record and applicable law.

Areas of Advisory & Representation

  • Criminal defence before Magistrate, Sessions, and Special Courts
  • High Court writ petitions and criminal appellate proceedings
  • Pre-trial bail, regular bail, and anticipatory bail advocacy
  • Corporate and commercial litigation support
  • Panel counsel services for public and private organizations

Consultation & Fee Policy

Our fee structure is transparent, ethical, and tailored to the engagement scope. Rates are confirmed directly after reviewing the matter's requirements. We do not solicit clients or advertise fees publicly.
